title: The Last Shift II
designPurpose: A heavier continuation identity for the mind after the shift: restrained tension, memory after transition, and faint repeated traces of thought that have already moved.

typography.quoteTreatment: Display serif italic with muted dusk-blue trace.

mobile.toolbar: compact shared toolbar; form controls remain at least 44px

semanticPageTypes.frontCover: Official image appears once as the first unnumbered page, object-fit contain, no crop, no theme filter.
semanticPageTypes.halfTitle: No separate half-title detected; source-driven title page follows the cover.
semanticPageTypes.titlePage: Source-driven title page preserves series, book number, manuscript title line, three subtitle lines, author, epigraph, publisher, and source collection line.
semanticPageTypes.copyrightPage: Compact front-matter page with restrained heading and no folio.
semanticPageTypes.dedication: Centered dedication page with quiet afterimage rules and no folio.
semanticPageTypes.epigraph: Opening epigraph uses italic display treatment inside the title page.
semanticPageTypes.contents: Unboxed source contents with arc headings, chapter rows, and muted leader rhythm.
semanticPageTypes.chapterOpening: Fresh page for every chapter; arc label sits above a heavy uppercase title with double-offset trace lines.
semanticPageTypes.normalContinuation: Warm paper, deep slate text, measured literary spacing, small first-line indent after adjacent paragraphs.
semanticPageTypes.sectionBreak: Two faint offset traces, 52px and 26px, using lavender-blue accent at low opacity.
semanticPageTypes.quotationTreatment: Short standalone quote lines and reader blockquotes use display serif italic and a muted trace.
semanticPageTypes.finalManuscriptPage: Final reflection, epilogue, and about-author pages receive a faint bottom residue wash.
semanticPageTypes.feedbackSurface: Whole-book feedback page inherits warm paper, natural-height mobile behavior, one trigger, and scoped form palette.

sourceAsset.format: JPEG original preserved as PNG reference
sourceAsset.note: The official artwork contains Greyveil Editions branding, series/book, title, Part II, second-layer subtitle, and lower tagline; no author name is visible on the cover image.

websiteAsset.optimization: Converted from the official JPEG at WebP quality 88 with complete artwork preserved.

printAsset.printReadiness: Best available full-resolution reference, not genuine 300 DPI production print art for a 5.5in x 8.5in trim.

targetDpi.availableEffectiveDpiAtReferenceTrim: approximately 186 DPI by width and 181 DPI by height, below 300 DPI target

coverSpecification.titlePlacement: Large centered title in middle/lower-middle, with THE above LAST SHIFT and Part II below.
coverSpecification.subtitlePlacement: Series/book line above title, Second Layer below Part II, lower tagline near bottom.
coverSpecification.authorPlacement: No author name visible in the available cover artwork.
coverSpecification.publisherMarkPlacement: Greyveil Editions logo and wordmark centered in the upper third.
coverSpecification.safeMargin: Preserve the existing internal gold border and keep all typography inside at least 7% visual margin when fitting pages.
coverSpecification.bleedGuidance: No bleed-ready paperback cover exists yet; do not crop for bleed without a higher-resolution master.
coverSpecification.colourProfileGuidance: Current source is RGB JPEG. Future print should request high-resolution RGB or CMYK cover master from the designer/printer.
coverSpecification.imageFitBehavior: Use object-fit: contain. Do not recolor, filter, stretch, crop, darken, or apply theme overlays to the official artwork.

WordCoverPageMapping.insertionGuidance: Insert PNG as a full first page using fit-to-page containment; disable Word image compression where possible.
WordCoverPageMapping.printLimitation: Replace before final print production if 300 DPI/bleed is required.

PdfCoverPageMapping.fitMode: Contain inside trim box unless a higher-resolution bleed-ready asset is supplied.
PdfCoverPageMapping.printLimitation: Suitable digital/PDF reference, not final print cover.

paperbackWrapStatus.status: Front cover only; full wrap, spine, and back cover are not included yet.
paperbackWrapStatus.spineGuidance: Spine width depends on final page count, paper stock, binding method, and printer specification.

responsiveAdaptations.mobile: Nearly full-width page, 18-22px safe padding, simplified trace motifs, body text no smaller than 17px, no horizontal overflow, natural-height feedback.
responsiveAdaptations.tablet: Centered page with balanced page proportions and clear chapter hierarchy.
responsiveAdaptations.desktop: 664px x 1026px page target, subtle edge/shadow, literary spacing, 60-72 character measure.

futureWordMapping.sectionBreak: two short offset rules in muted dusk/lavender tint

futurePdfMapping.printEquivalent: warm ivory stock, deep slate text, muted dusk/lavender accent traces

sharedFiles: /assets/js/reader.js only for reusable source-driven opening/header roles/part drawer support
